run_make_unicode_casefold: run the python script to generate C++ Unicode case folding tables for RE2 regex library
create_Delta_function: create a function that computes delta values between Unicode code points handling EvenOdd and OddEven transitions
create_AddDelta_function: create a function that adds delta values to Unicode code points with special EvenOdd and OddEven handling
create_MakeRanges_function: create a function that converts Unicode character pairs into compact ranges with delta encoding
generate_unicode_casefold_tables: generate C++ case folding and tolower tables from Unicode case groups using the RE2 tool
